snow.config.title: Snow
snow.config.option.description.accumulat: Snow builds up to a per-biome height during snowfall, at a per-biome rate. Very snowy biomes can reach 12 layers.
snow.config.option.description.generatio: Newly generated chunks place a random number of snow layers based on the biome.
snow.config.option.description.melting.g: Snow melts one layer at a time instead of all at once.
snow.config.option.description.melting.m: Snow melts in biomes where it would rain instead of snow, regardless of light level.
